about: How a reply button looks (docs/protocol.md, "Reply buttons"): ready, pressing, pressed (with the thread it started or messaged) or failed (with why), from the button's row and this app's own press. input.button is the row (kind start or send, pressedThreadId, failed); input.press is this app's press: none, sending (on its way to the backend), or the backend's word for its command (pending, taken, done with a threadId, failed with a note). The desktop app (desktop/core/src/reply_buttons.rs look), the iPhone (ReplyButtons.look), Android (ReplyButtons.look) and the website (web/src/reply-buttons.ts buttonLook). expect has threadId only when pressed and error only when failed.

a done press is pressed, with the thread to open
